listing.name: Battletech Portrait Pack
listing.summary: Because I got tired of the game yelling at me for the game version being out of date.
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 100 character portraits from Battletech and additional ship names.

description:
Do you guys like Battletech?

Of course you do, I've seen the Discord.  So why not take a bunch of characters from that other game in a dystopian sci-fi future where mankind uses its precious, irreplaceable technology to kill each other and make them available in a game where mankind uses its precious, irreplaceable technology to kill each other?

Featuring:

Over 100 new and interesting people to hire and/or shoot at, most of whom are absolutely not the advance scouts of a warrior society descended from a star-spanning empire's exiled military!
Tweaked to (hopefully) look somewhat decent in Starsector!
Everybody from HBS' Battletech is here, even the awful guy you immediately put in an unarmored Spider and send off to receive his viking funeral!
BONUS NEW GREAT VALUE! Additional ship names pulled from a night wiki-walking Sarna.net, ported into Starsector!  Replace the 500 Drams named "Old Earth or Bust" in the market with 500 Drams named "Bloodlettter!"  (What scope creep?)
Do you want your character to be a parrot wearing sunglasses, but you're afraid that everyone is going to judge you if you download the furry portrait pack?  With this mod, you can!

Download

Please let me know if you encounter any issues/graphical wonkery/want to yell at me about how the katana dude(s) isn't in the portrait list for your favorite faction.

aiDescription: Adds over 100 character portraits from Battletech, tweaked to fit the game's style. It also includes additional ship names sourced from Battletech lore, allowing players to replace default names with Battletech-themed ones.
